title: Molecular Mechanism of the Asarum-Angelica Drug Pair in the Treatment of Periodontitis Based on Network Pharmacology and Experimental Verification.
authors: Chen, Qianyang; Wang, Yuhan; Shi, Chun; Tong, Meichen; Sun, Haibo; Dong, Ming; Liu, Shuo; Wang, Lina
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和细胞实验研究中药药对治疗牙周炎的机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: (1) To examine the potential mechanism of the Asarum-Angelica drug pair against periodontitis and provide an experimental basis for the treatment of periodontitis with herbal medicine. (2) The core components and core targets of the Asarum-Angelica drug pair in the treatment of periodontitis were detected according to network pharmacology methods. Finally, the effect of the Asarum-Angelica drug pair on osteogenic differentiation was observed in mouse embryonic osteoblast precursor cells. (3) According to the results of network pharmacology, there are 10 potential active ingredients in the Asarum-Angelica drug pair, and 44 potential targets were obtained by mapping the targets with periodontitis treatment. Ten potential active ingredients, such as kaempferol and beta-sitosterol, may play a role in treating periodontitis. Cell experiments showed that the Asarum-Angelica drug pair can effectively promote the expression of osteoblast markers alkaline phosphatase (ALP), Runt-related Transcription Factor 2 (RUNX2), and BCL2 mRNA and protein in an inflammatory environment (p < 0.05). (4) Network pharmacology effectively analyzed the molecular mechanism of Asarum-Angelica in the treatment of periodontitis, and the Asarum-Angelica drug pair can promote the differentiation of osteoblasts.
abstract_zh: (1) 探讨细辛-当归药对治疗牙周炎的潜在机制，为草药治疗牙周炎提供实验依据。(2) 通过网络药理学方法检测细辛-当归药对治疗牙周炎的核心成分和核心靶点。最后，在小鼠胚胎成骨前体细胞中观察细辛-当归药对成骨分化的影响。(3) 网络药理学结果显示，细辛-当归药对中有10种潜在活性成分，通过与牙周炎治疗靶点映射获得44个潜在靶点。山奈酚和β-谷甾醇等10种潜在活性成分可能在治疗牙周炎中发挥作用。细胞实验表明，细辛-当归药对在炎症环境中能有效促进成骨标志物碱性磷酸酶（ALP）、Runt相关转录因子2（RUNX2）和BCL2 mRNA及蛋白的表达（p < 0.05）。(4) 网络药理学有效分析了细辛-当归治疗牙周炎的分子机制，且细辛-当归药对能促进成骨细胞分化。
